tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /kyai rdor lam dus ma nor don gsal bzhugs/ /༈/na mo gu ru we/dpal kyai rdo rje gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs la lus dkyil dang lam dus kyi dab
༄༅/ /kyai rdor lam dus ma nor don gsal bzhugs/ /༈/na mo gu ru we/dpal kyai rdo rje gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs la lus dkyil dang lam dus kyi dab

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// kyai rdor lam dus ma nor don gsal bzhugs// ༈ /na mo gu ru we/ dpal kyai rdo rje gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs la lus dkyil dang lam dus kyi dbang sbyar ba'i ngag 'don ni/ skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur dmigs te/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/

yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ he ru ka'i sku gang*/ de nas dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus kyi mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste/ spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/ rang skad cig gis dpal kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sems gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po/

de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu la brgyan pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar te/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ namaḥshrī he badz+ra maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ snying ga'i hūm̐ las spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams te/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma ri ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol ba mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces brjod/ chos thams cad rang gi sems kyi snang ba/ de'ang rang rig pa sgyu ma lta bu/ de'ang rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du shes par byas la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ dang am̐ las thod pa dang gri gu hūm̐ dang am̐ gis mtshan pa las rang nyid dpal kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud ka zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang ser po/ lnga pa na rnga mong thal ka drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang gu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/

bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbur brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa// dgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi// gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid// de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskums pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pa'i rkyen gyis skad cig gis rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsib ma rdo rje'i rwa ba/ pags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ ba spu mda'i drwa ba/ sen mo me ri 'bar ba ste srung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ rkang mthil rlung*/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/

mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ lus mi mnyam pa med pa gru bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying ga nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i bu ga bzhi sgo bzhi/ mig pañtsa re khā/ sna rin po che'i pha gu/ so drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa/ lce dang mchu 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ rna ba rta babs/ rkang rnams ka ba brgyad de rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte ba'i am̐/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dang tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sa rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ gsang gnas bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i lte ba'i hā/ phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das phrin las don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rlung rnam par dag pa dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo so gnyis kyis bskor ba bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte ba'i hūm̐/ zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum chu rnam par dag pa mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/

gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte ba'i oṃ/ 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pad+ma g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum me rnam par dag pa gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo bcu drug gis bskor ba so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i lte ba'i haṃ/ gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum nam mkha'i khams rnam par dag pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo so gnyis kyis bskor ba chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gtso bo lnga po thams cad dbu'i gtsug tor blta bar mi mngon pa la sogs pa mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ sen po zangs kyi mdog ltar dmar ba la sogs dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ gzhan yang mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lcer 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ snying khar bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de dag gi mdun du zhal nang la phyogs pa'i tshul gyis mig tu gzugs gau rī/

rna bar sgra tsau rī/ snar dri be ta lī/ lcer ro ghasma rī/ dpral bar reg sa spyod ma/ snying gar chos khams mkha' spyod ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ lag pa g.yas par gshin rje'i gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon par shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ lcer pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas su bgegs mthar byed sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dpung pa g.yas par mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yon par 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon par stobs po che sngon po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ spyi gtsug tu gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ lha de thams cad kyang sku dbyibs/ rnam pa bde ba/ rang bzhin stong gsal/ ngo bo zung 'jug gzhan yang lus rtsa sprul pa'i sku/ rtsa yi ge longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ khams bdud rtsi chos kyi sku/ snying po ye shes rlung ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol ba mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pa// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces pas mchod/

oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes pas gsol ba btab pas/ dbang lha rigs lnga'i phyag na bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas dbang bskur bar bsams la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bcas te dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ des chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag yang de dag gis rin po che'i cod pan mgo la bcing nas dbang bskur bar mos la/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+ra rā ga ta badz+ra sha li hoḥ des cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag yang de dag gis lag pa g.yas su rdo rje byin nas dbang bskur bar mos la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs// des rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag yang de dag gis lag pa g.yon par dril bu byin nas dbang bskur bar mos la/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti twaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ des dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/

bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag yang de dag gis ming gi dbang bskur bar mos la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣi ka ta kye/ dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// des ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag yang de dag gis lag pa g.yas su rdo rje byin nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// lag pa g.yon du dril bu byin nas/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// dril bu'i sgra kun rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed// lag pa gnyis kas 'khyud rgya byas la/ dbang lhas/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs ni bsdu bar gyis// zhes gsungs pas dam tshig gsum thob par bsam/ yang de dag gis/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob par bsam/ de ltar na bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// gsang dbang ni/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol ba mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mchod la/

bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga po mi bskyod pa'i rnam par bsdus/ mi bskyod pa thabs shes snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems mu tig gi rdog ma lta bu bdag gi lce thog la bzhag par bsams la/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni// sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro// thig le de mgrin pa nas 'phel te lus thams cad gang bas rlung nang du ldog cing rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa rags rim 'gag par bsam/ de ltar na rdzas gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam tsaṇ+ḍa li bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag sher dbang ni/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol ba mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces mchod/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ mi bskyod pa'i yum las mā ma kī gcig bye ba/

bdag la gtad nas dbang lhas/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis// zhes gsungs par bsam/ rig ma de bdag nyid kyi yum la thim nas/ de dang snyoms par zhugs pas yas 'bab dang mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong bar bsam/ de ltar na phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag dbang bzhi pa ni/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol ba mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod// 'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces mchod/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// dbang bskur gsum po bdag la gnang*// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa// bzhi pa yang ni byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dbang gi lhas/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes gsung bar bsams la/ rang gi sems kyi gshis ci yang ma yin pa/ gdangs bde chen du ma 'gags pa/ rtsal lha skur 'char ba/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bur shes par byas la 'dzin med du bzhag de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lam rdo rje rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag de ltar na dbang gi chu rgyun des lus thams cad gang dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/

chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las phyi he ru ka yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ zhes brjod cing bsams la lha'i nga rgyal dang gsal snang la sems bzung*/ de nas bzlas pa byed na/ yum gyi thugs ka'i am̐ las sngags 'phreng byung zhal nas thon/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma nas zhugs te mgal me ltar 'khor ba'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ aṣ+ṭā na nā ya/ piṅga lor+dhā ke sha warta ma ne/ tsa turbing+sha ti ni trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇi dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā lā ne dhā ri ṇe/ adh+mā ta krū ra tsit+tā ya/ ar+dhen+du daṃṣ+ṭī ṇe/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardzadza ya gardzadza ya/ tardzadza ya tardzadza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga rān/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ nā gā ṣ+ṭa kān/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sha trūn/ ha hā hi hī hu hū he hai ho hau haṃ haḥphaṭa swāhā/ zhes nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs ci nus dang*/ spro na/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥ.am̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'ang cung zad bzlas mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub snying po kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ yum yab la thim/ yab kyi zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim/ rang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/

spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dges pa rdo rje 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// smyo med kyai yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug pa'i rang dang snang ba thams cad lha'i 'khor lor zhes pas/ zas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi/ snying ga'i hūm̐ lha thams cad kyi ngo bor mchod par bsam pas longs spyad/ nub mor lhar snang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su sbyangs te nyal/ tho rangs lha'i rnal 'byor gyis langs te lam zab mo'i rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya'o// 'di ni kyai rdor gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs la lus dkyil sbyar/ dbang ni gzhung bshad sras don ma las lam dus kyi dbang blang tshul rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gsung ba las/ 'dir rgyas pa de blang*/ de la dbang tshig rgyud nas bstan pa rnams la 'gyur 'dra min cung zad 'dug pa rnams ni 'don brjod bde ba'i phyir lus dkyil mdzes rgyan ltar bris/ dbang bzhi so so'i sngon gyi mchod pa sogs la 'dra min cung zad 'dug pa rnams ni/ dam pa gzhan gyi gsung rab dang yang cung zad bstun nas brjod bde don 'dus gtso bor byas mdor na kho bos rang bzor byas nas bris pa cung zad kyang med pas dpyod ldan rnams kyis de bzhin dgongs par mdzod cig

ces pa 'di ni mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyis mngon par mtho ba sprul sku rin po che kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis tshul 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba'i ngor shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas bris pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phreng ba mdun du 'dus byas la/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa/ lag pa'i mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ bar tshar gcig brjod/ g.yon skor du gnas pa'i lte bar a/ lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo rnams rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ lag pa'i mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa/ ha k+ṣaḥ'i bar tshar gcig g.yas skor du gnas pa'i lte bar hūm̐ bsam/ de nas pad skor sngon du 'gro bas phreng ba blang la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las bdud rtsi'i yi ge sum̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros par bsam/ lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du phreng ba bzung la/ thal mo phan tshun bsrub pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ rdo rje dang pad+ma snyoms par zhugs byang chub kyi sems sum̐ la khyab/ de ā li kā li la khyab/ de phreng ba dang gnyis su med par gyur/ zhes brjod la/ oṃ pa de pa de mahā dz+nyā na/ sarba bud+dha ma yaṃ bha wi te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes phreng ba gsar pa la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ de phyin sngags 'di nyer gcig gam bdun nam gsum bzla bar bya'o// zhes rgyud dngos las byung ba'i phreng ba byin rlabs kyi le'u tshan no// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
